name: mangashelf
description: MangaShelf - Plataforma de hospedagem de mangás self-hosted

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: psql -h localhost -U mangashelf -d mangashelf -f migrations/0001_initial/up.sql && psql -h localhost -U mangashelf -d mangashelf -f migrations/0002_add_storage_key_chapters/up.sql && psql -h localhost -U mangashelf -d mangashelf -f migrations/0003_add_pages_table/up.sql
scripts.db:reset: psql -h localhost -U mangashelf -d mangashelf -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" && npm run db:migrate
